method: Complete independent Git snapshot of all current tracked files plus revision files, bundled with --all; incremental bundle of a temporary candidate commit against the accepted prior-round commit. Both verified with git bundle verify.
limitations: Some historical Git objects are unavailable, so a full-ancestry bundle is not claimed. Complete current-tree and incremental submission bundles were measured instead.
Workspace Git metadata is read-only. Commits/bundles were made only in the disposable validation checkout; the publisher must commit the prepared workspace files.
